title: LMM API 新旧站点浏览器实测证据（脱敏摘要）
scope: Developer-machine public Chromium browsing and read-only documented HTTP requests, plus existing-user Chrome UI observation. No new credentials, financial writes, paid provider requests, deployment or load test.

findings.legacy: LMM Forge；导航较多，主文案为 AI 模型，一处接入。
findings.native: LMM API；工具市场、价格、开发者与更多导航，主文案为 AI 工具，汇聚同一个社区。

findings.legacy: /pricing 与 /tool-market 跳转 /sign-in 并保留 redirect。
findings.native: /pricing 与 /tool-market 跳转 /sign-in 并保留 redirect。

findings.legacy: 显示注册、Google、GitHub、Discord、LinuxDO、Telegram、Passkey。仅观察入口，未验证各供应商登录成功。
findings.native: 未显示注册；GitHub、Telegram 标为仅限登录；支持密码及 Passkey 入口。仅观察入口，未验证各供应商登录成功。

findings.legacy: 已登录会话可打开 dashboard/overview 与 wallet，余额、用量图表、人民币支付预览表单可见。未支付。
findings.native: Existing-session recovery followed by explicit browser-session renewal succeeded and opened /dashboard/overview. Fresh password/OAuth login, registration and revocation were not tested.

findings.legacy: 有请求构建器；默认示例模型可见。
findings.native: 有当前域名请求构建器；显示模型目录暂时不可用，可手工输入模型 ID；OAuth 服务发现链接仍指向 api.lmm.best。需确认正式发行的 canonical 地址策略。

findings.legacy: Balance and cumulative usage/API-count fields plus CNY Waffo Pancake amount/payment-preview form visible. No payment submitted.
findings.native: Credit balance and reference currency visible; cumulative usage/API-count shown unavailable; recharge says no available payment channels. Trust-level L0/discount card still visible in sampled UI.
findings.qualification: No balances or user identifiers retained. L0 may be the UI missing-value default, not an audited role or financial rate.
Different snapshots and user scopes were not reconciled. Counts do not measure migration completion or runnable model coverage. No provider invocation performed.

findings.legacy: Existing-account historical totals and charts are visible.
findings.native: Personal current usage empty; personal cumulative statistics unavailable; lower charts explicitly aggregate all accounts including imported history.
findings.qualification: Different aggregation scopes; no inference of financial data loss from visible totals.

native.seller_display: Generic user identifier instead of legacy display profile/official marker

findings.qualification: Seller personal details omitted. Search only; no inventory or financial mutation.

findings.legacy: Same sampled product detail renders; stock 0; Add to cart disabled.
findings.native: Same sampled product detail renders; stock 0; Add to cart disabled.
findings.qualification: Only the out-of-stock flow passed; in-stock purchase/delivery/refund were not tested.
Discovery only. Browser session recovery is a separate path. Native 503 reconfirmed in final public checks.

findings.native: /keys loads; base URL ends in /v1 with do-not-append-twice guidance; manual-key tab shows empty state.
findings.qualification: Auto-key tab, legacy-key list, issue/revoke/migration behavior were not tested. Empty manual tab does not prove no keys.

findings.native: API, database, model-routing readiness indicators green. Existing-session 24-hour view reports no request samples. Anonymous view shows login requirement for historical performance.
findings.qualification: /health/ready explicitly says configured_components and upstream_health_checked=false. Component readiness does not establish external provider success, billing correctness, or availability SLA.

facts: Wallet trust-level card and L0/0% missing-field defaults remain.
Main baseline 48f343f contains retirement fixes not present in the sampled Web source.
findings.qualification: Exact running Core binary was not identified. Source pricing branches do not establish which rate is active in production.

limitations: No production database access or modification.
No new production accounts, API keys, payments, refunds, paid model calls, deployment or load tests.
Public pages used an isolated Chromium browser context; existing-user checks used the user's Chrome session; account-data equivalence has not been established.
Raw screenshots, account balances, personal identifiers, tokens and browser storage are excluded.
version_warning: Web build changed during observation. Earlier UI observations are not all bound to the final Web build; no complete Core/Extensions/Web/CLI/schema/config release bundle was audited. Cause of the change was not inferred.

error.message: Core billing, identity and forwarding are not enabled. Keep production on the existing Go service.

interpretation_limits: external_model_providers_enabled=false and payments_enabled=false in public /api/status are fixed declarations in inspected source, not an exhaustive runtime configuration audit.
Anonymous pricing_forbidden 403 is an application access-policy response, not proof of missing catalog or an edge access-control failure.
Token price — and routing unknown need billing_status, price dimension, group rule and runtime-status contract examination; they do not by themselves prove absent model implementation.
Successful fresh login, paid provider operation, purchase, payment settlement, restore, failover and capacity qualification remain untested.
completed_actions: Existing-session recovery/renewal through visible application controls
